greeting: Signs! Signs! Everywhere there's signs! And I paint them ALL!
Brushmaster Banner, at your brush! Billboard artist extraordinaire!
Welcome! Need signage? I'm your guy! Any size! Any message!
The sky is my canvas! The buildings are my... slightly smaller canvases!
Looking for visibility? I make VISIBLE!
Signs tell stories! I tell them with paint!
Hello! Admiring my work? It's everywhere! Literally!
dialog.commission_offer: Need a sign? I do hand-painted! Digital! Animated! Sky-writing! You name it!
dialog.portfolio_show: See that one? 'Cloud Nails!' And that one? 'Sky-High Sweets!' I'm EVERYWHERE!
dialog.paint_philosophy: A sign without soul is just... a board. I give them SOUL! With color! With flair!
haggle: Art is priceless! But my time costs money!
For you? I'll throw in extra sparkles! Free!
Bulk discount! Three signs, ten percent off!
Fine! Twenty percent! But I keep the creative control!
commission_accept: EXCELLENT! Your vision! My brush! Magic!
This will be my masterpiece! One of many!
Sign me up! Get it? Sign? I'll paint now!
commission_reject: No budget? No billboard! Harsh reality!
Paint costs money! Dreams cost less, but still something!
Save up! Good signs are worth it!
rumor: Painted a sign for the twins once. They wanted TWO identical ones. Creepy.
The trenchcoat person's sign changes when I'm not looking. Impossible, but true!
Crimson's sign keeps catching fire. Design flaw?
Something near the Vault makes my paint... wrong. Colors don't work there!
The sunandmoon wanted a celestial mural. Still working on it!
dialog.quest_hook: I need Pigment Crystals! From the Prism Caves! For my ULTIMATE palette! Three crystals and I'll paint you a personal masterpiece!
dialog.quest_active: Those crystals gleaming yet? I can almost see the colors!
dialog.quest_complete: THE SPECTRUM! So pure! So vibrant! Your portrait! In my BEST work yet!
dialog.quest_reward: Banner's Masterpiece - Portrait that boosts reputation in all zones!
farewell: Keep your eyes UP! That's where my work is!
Sign off! ...Get it? Paint you later!
May your message be seen! By everyone!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning light! Best for seeing true colors!
dialog.time_noon: Bright sun! Colors pop! Visibility maximum!
dialog.time_dusk: Golden hour! My favorite painting light!
dialog.time_night: Night painting! With luminescent pigments! Glow signs!

party_reactions.nix7: Your work has a 23% error rate. I have been counting.
party_reactions.twist: I saw your signs! They're EVERYWHERE!
party_reactions.korr: A craftsman of visibility. Honorable work.
party_reactions.renna: The color theory is... adequate. The scale is impressive.
party_reactions.suresh: Every sign marks a point in someone's journey. Meaningful.
party_reactions.sova: Good for navigation. I use them as landmarks.
party_reactions.grit: Paint? In this economy? Digital is cheaper.
party_reactions.ashka: Can you make signs with FIRE? That would be AWESOME!
party_reactions.senna: Ever paint a 'wrong way' sign? For... reasons?
party_reactions.callum: So talented! So many colors! So BIG!

relationship_dialog.stranger: Need a sign? I'm your artist!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning customer! Or admirer! Both good!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite patron! I have ideas for you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Creative soulmate! Let's paint the town! Literally!

mini_quest.title: Prismatic Pigments
mini_quest.description: Find Pigment Crystals from Prism Caves for Banner's ultimate palette

stages.hook: Pigment Crystals! Three of them! For my MASTERPIECE palette!
stages.active: Prism Caves! Deep and colorful! You'll know them!
stages.complete: THE COLORS! Your portrait! My finest work!
